formulation_checks: Eliminating d ln rho/dr from spherical mass conservation and P=rho a^2 gives (v-a^2/v) dv/dr=2a^2/r-da^2/dr-GMp/r^2+kappa r. Constant mu is required for the recorded a^2=kBT/(mu mp).
With x=ln(r/R), q=ln(v/a), beta=d ln a^2/dx, the left side becomes (exp(2q)-1)(q_x+beta/2). The code numerator has positive outward linear tide and negative inward planetary gravity.
Differentiating at q=N=0 gives 2 q_x^2+beta q_x-N_x=0; the positive root selects the accelerating Mach-number branch. The physical logarithmic velocity slope adds beta/2.

The two Chebyshev pieces share the sonic node. Three residual rows impose q_c=0 and the regular slope from each side; the other rows use the momentum residual. The scalar and vector custom_root calls differentiate both the critical point and the moving discretization.

The analytic isothermal root uses the same accelerating branch as Cranmer Eq16, with a sonic series and custom JVP. Both public velocity functions return km/s; the sound speed and gravity algebra are in cgs.

sources_inspected.supports: Steady spherical continuity, isothermal momentum/critical point and two Lambert-W wind branches. General-temperature and tidal terms are provider-derived additions, not attributed to this paper.
Independent implementation uses the same 3GMstar/a_orbit^3 linear tidal coefficient in the isothermal integrated equation. Source comparison only; p-winds was not executed.

numerical_checks.analytic_limits: SciPy Lambert W against the separate isothermal implementation; constant-temperature nonisothermal/no-tide limit; integrated isothermal tide equation; analytic cooling power-law critical point.
numerical_checks.independent_solver: SciPy brentq/DOP853 sonic shooting at selected heating-profile top temperatures 6000, 13177, 22149, 30000 K without tides and 6000, 14000, 30000 K with tides; velocity relative tolerance 2e-7. This solver uses the same physical ODE.
numerical_checks.derivatives: JAX parameter derivatives against central differences; reverse/forward-mode agreement; sonic slope and moving-critical-point continuity; 129 versus 257 point value/gradient convergence. Tests use per-case tolerances recorded in pinned source, not one universal bound.
numerical_checks.failure_behavior: Invalid interval/grid and negative, nonfinite or excessive tidal coefficients tested.

remaining_limits: Prescribed temperature; no solved energy balance.
Constant mu; no ionization-to-wind molecular-weight feedback.
Spherical continuity with a linear axis tide is not multidimensional Roche geometry.
Single regular sonic point; no-tide isothermal initializer critical point must also lie inside the interval.
Discrete implicit derivatives require a converged isolated root and nonsingular residual Jacobian. No NUTS posterior validity is inferred.
